content: The model fixes typos, but it mainly manages cases where two letters are needed but one is written and vice versa, for example "detailled" is corrected to "detailed" and ‘planing’ to "planning". More complicated mistakes are missed, especially if combined with other error types, and in some sentences a misspelled word is changed into an incorrect form that has a common ending, like "misundrestood" to "misundrested". The results get better if the input has been automatically spell-checked.
